scope: pilot_smoke or full32; independent zero-tick scene shots, not a trajectory

public_npz_exact_keys.depth_m: float32 [4,256,256], metric camera-Z, invalid depth preserved
public_npz_exact_keys.public_sphere_center: float64 [3], one initial public RGBD marker fit per parent, immutable
public_npz_exact_keys.timestamp: finite scalar actual scene clock 0 for each independent zero-tick shot

labels_sibling_npz.semantic_role_ids: uint8 [4,256,256]: 0 background,1 visible Cube,2 visible renderable goalSphere,255 ignore
labels_sibling_npz.cube_center_world: float64 [3], offline oracle/score only; NaN allowed if cube_present=false
labels_sibling_npz.optional_privileged_fields: rendered_instance_ids and Cube pose may be retained only here or labels metadata; never input features

manifest.sphere_calibration_hash: data.calibration_digest: SHA256 canonical JSON sorted K/T/camera_names lists
manifest.role_mapping: declared calibration explicitly maps to internal calib, original role retained; no fold migration

crop.center: round-half-up projection of immutable public sphere
crop.padding: zero features plus explicit invalid-crop mask; labels ignore255
crop.relative_geometry: camera point minus camera sphere, divided by0.1m; no absolute worldXYZ

Cube_far_rule: Never relabel real visible Cube pixels background. Correct segmentation outside near_scope remains semantically correct; refiner_available=false from PUBLIC derived geometry scope gate.
Sphere_only_rule: zero Cube instance label only if no Cube rendered; fully invisible Cube is unobserved, never completed from GT
geometry: current masked actual depth, original q01/q99 midpoint with z=q98-.025 and min(1,views/3)*min(1,points/60); orientation unobserved identity prior, no history or completed cloud
unknown: low pixel confidence, crop boundary contact, <12 real depth points, <2 views, original geometry confidence<.5 or public8cm scope failure
pre_fit_oracle_gate: visible Cube label mask + REAL depth + SAME geometry. Report coverage/group/max; qualified-visible centre P95<=.005m is necessary, not sufficient. Failure stops before NN fit, never substitutes GT centre.

training.weights: random fresh UNet8, four views shared
training.parent_weighting: all8shots and4views equal; every parent equal
training.calibration: calibration4 only chooses lowest [.5,.7,.9,.95,.99] meeting Cube pixel precision>=.995, both Sphere-only/Cube-far present with zero falseavailable, qualified-visible centre P95<=.005m; none=>unqualified
